description: This file declares functions related to MMC/SD card operations, including initialization, status check, logging, and reading log file content.

methods.name: isSdCardAlive
methods.description: Checks if the SD card is currently active and responsive.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a line of text to the log stored on the SD card.

methods.name: readLogFileContent
methods.description: Reads content from the log file into a buffer, given file ID, offset, and length.
